newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Hansapank up on Helsinki buying.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Hansapank up on Helsinki buying.

text.p: Shares in leading Estonian bank Hansapank were boosted on Wednesday amid buying in its Helsinki-quoted shares, dealers said.
Hansapank ended up 4.05 kroons at 194 kroons, up from 190.05 kroons, in Tallinn. In Helsinki, they gained 1.50 markka to 72.50 markka on volume of 5,000.
Helsinki-based brokers gave differing reasons for the move higher.
"An explanation seems to be that there is some large bullish eastern investment funds who are interested in Hansapank," said one broker, who declined to be identified.
Another trader said that some speculative interest may have been sparked by a Finnish television programme, which focused on Baltic banks.
"It said that Hansapank was the largest and the best so there could some small investor speculation happening here as well," the trader said.
Hansapank is the largest bank in the Baltic states and has a large proportion of foreign investors.
